message: The max-width 480px rules change the layout structure: the base has "<td width="200" valign="top" style="width:33.33%;padding:0 0 0 8px;">" where this screen has "</tr>"
hint: Head rules can change padding, sizes, colours, show or hide blocks and stack a flex row or grid (flex-direction: column, display: block, one grid track) on narrow screens, but not change the column count, reverse the order or turn a column into a row; fluid rows already wrap on phones.
